name: Mashhad Metro
tagline: Find your way around the Mashhad Metro system
description:
Mashhad Metro is a mobile app for navigating the metro system in Mashhad, Iran. It helps you plan trips, find stations, and figure out routes across the network, all built on OpenStreetMap data.

It's a focused, city-specific transit companion for anyone who rides the Mashhad Metro regularly or is just visiting.
